part: SN74HCS165 (8-bit parallel-load shift register, Schmitt-trigger inputs; SN74HCS165DR = LCSC C2864745)
notes: TI SCLS828A, Aug 2020 rev May 2021, 35 pp incl. package addendum dated 3-May-2026 (SN74HCS165DR Active). Candidate for review finding K1-1. Pinout p3 is pin-for-pin the 74HC165 (SH/LD=PL 1, CLK=CP 2, E-H=D4-D7 3-6, /QH 7, GND 8, QH 9, SER=DS 10, A-D=D0-D3 11-14, CLK INH=CE 15, VCC 16). VCC 2-6 V (p4). VT+/VT-/dVT given ONLY at 2, 4.5 and 6 V (p6) - there is NO 3.3 V row. No input transition-rate limit in Recommended Operating Conditions; p15: 'has no input signal transition rate requirements because it has Schmitt-trigger inputs'.

part: 74HCS165 (Nexperia, 8-bit parallel-in/serial out shift register with Schmitt-trigger inputs)
notes: Nexperia 74HCS165 Rev. 1, 5 June 2025, 20 pp. Same pinout as 74HC165 (p3-4). THE DOCUMENT WITH A 3.3 V ROW (Table 6 p6): VCC 3.0-3.6 V: VT+ 0.4-0.7 VCC, VT- 0.2-0.5 VCC, VH 0.1 VCC min / 0.72 V typ / 0.38 VCC max. No dt/dV row in Recommended Operating Conditions (p6). NOT stocked at LCSC/JLC as of 2026-09-27 (JLC search '74HCS165' returns only TI parts). Its p1 feature list carries 'Storage register with 3-state outputs' and 'Shift register with direct clear' - copied from another part; the 165 has neither.

part: 74LV165A (Nexperia) - checked as a K1-1 candidate and REJECTED
notes: Nexperia 74LV165A Rev. 5, 18 April 2024, 16 pp. Banked as the counter-example: p1 says 'Schmitt-trigger action at all inputs, makes the circuit tolerant for slower input rise and fall times', yet Recommended Operating Conditions still cap dt/dV at 100 ns/V for VCC 3.0-3.6 V (200 ns/V at 2.3-2.7 V, 20 ns/V at 4.5-5.5 V). 'Schmitt-trigger action' is not the same as no transition-rate limit.

part: PEM microPEM fasteners bulletin MPF (TMSO4 / MSO4 / MSOFS M2 standoffs)
notes: PEM bulletin MPF, footer 2/18/26, 24 pp. The only PEM bulletin with M2 self-clinching standoffs (review findings K4-2, K5-5). MPF-4 TMSO4-M2: min sheet 0.2, hole 4.0 +0.05, C max 3.96, H 4.8, L 2 or 3, min hole C/L to edge 4.32, hardened 400 stainless. MPF-5 MSO4-M2: min sheet 0.3, hole 3.18 +0.05, C max 3.16, H 3.96, L 2 or 3 (+0.05/-0.08), min hole C/L to edge 3. MSOFS-M2 (flaring): sheet 0.2-0.3 only, hole 3.5, C/L to edge 2. MPF-14: MSO4 for sheet hardness HRB 88/HB 183 or less, TMSO4 HRC 37/HB 340 or less. No max sheet thickness and no aluminium test data are published for MSO4/TMSO4.

PEM bulletin SO, footer 6/12/26, 16 pp. Banked to settle review finding K4-2: its metric part tables have NO M2. SO/SOS/SOA/SO4 metric start at M3 (SO-3: M3 min sheet 1, hole 4.22, C/L to edge 6); TSO metric starts at M2.5 (SO-6: M25 min sheet 0.63, hole 4.22, C/L to edge 5.8; lengths 2.00-19.00 in 0.02 steps, same page); SOK/SOKS close-to-edge M2.5: min sheet 0.94, hole 4.22, C/L to edge 3.2 (SO-7). The SO-10 tooling table lists '440/M2/M2.5/M3' but no M2 part appears in any dimension table. Page 3 says 'Micro sizes also available. See PEM Bulletin MPF'.
